problems: raw/pg-djvu/154.txt is the patrologiaecurs147migngoog OCR; the archive item's own cut of the Elenchus is heavily garbled (author head for Maximus Chrysoberga read 'SAMAXINDS').
Column map is sparse and page numbers are often lost; most bodyCol values were set from page-header lines read with --near, not from the 'col ≈' lag value.
Professio fidei bodyCol 1297 is inferred (no page number at the head); possible +-1.

Items in the Ordo/body that the Elenchus omits and that are NOT entered: Philotheus CP 'Notitia ex Fabricio' (line 53749, col ~713; Ordo '744' garbled), Monitum Editorum before Maximus (line 92848), Monitum in orationem Demetrii (72522), Monitum in orationem sequentem (76084), Index rerum et verborum in Cantacuzeni Historiam (line 94754, cols 1241-1284), ADDENDA heading. The 'Tomus factus a Patriarcha Joanne' (line 52428) is part of the Contra Barlaam entry.
Elenchus parenthetical cross-references (Philotheus Antirrhetici/Encomium/Vita Demetrii/diplomata) entered as crossref items; no column is given for any of them.
Ordo columns are heavily garbled in this volume (851 for 835, 939 for 959, 345 for 745, 695 for 693), so Elenchus/body agreement carried most confirmations.
